concepts.caption: Me when the heated floor turns on
concepts.title: Heated Floor Turned On. He Melted Instantly ♨️🐱
concepts.en_line: The first cold night of the season, the floor heating clicks on and one fluffy cat stops being solid.

shots.image: Photorealistic fluffy lynx point Birman cat with a semi-long silky creamy-white body coat, a seal-brown tabby-striped face mask, seal-brown striped ears and a fluffy striped seal-brown tail, pure white gloved front and back paws, and deep sapphire-blue eyes, sitting upright in the middle of a warm honey-colored wooden floor in a cozy minimalist living room at night, a soft beige floor cushion and a small potted plant behind it, warm golden lamp light, gentle warm haze rising from the floor, the whole cat fully in frame and clearly visible, vertical composition
shots.motion: From the very first frame the lynx point Birman cat kneads the warm wooden floor with both white front paws, left right left right, while its blue eyes squint into a happy slow blink and its ears relax sideways. Its fluffy body sinks a little lower toward the warm floor and its striped tail sways slowly behind it. Soft warm haze shimmers above the floor. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same fluffy lynx point Birman cat with the same fur pattern, face and eye color. The cat is now melted completely flat on the same warm honey-colored wooden floor, lying stretched out on its side with its front paws reaching forward and its back legs stretched long behind, white paws relaxed, fluffy belly fur spread out, head resting on the floor facing the camera with blissful half-closed sapphire-blue eyes, same cozy living room with the beige cushion and potted plant, warm golden lamp light, gentle warm haze above the floor, the whole cat fully in frame. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: From the very first frame the melted Birman cat slowly stretches its front legs farther forward along the warm floor, spreading its white toes, then gives a long slow blissful blink and lets its striped tail sway lazily across the wood. Its belly rises and falls in calm breaths and it stays lying flat. Soft warm haze shimmers above the floor. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: Mid-November brings the first truly cold nights in Korea and across the northern hemisphere, when floor heating and heaters come on for the season; cozy and wholesome cat memes are what cat-meme sites are featuring this week.
trend.pattern: relatable 'me when…' cold-weather beat: the first second shows the cat already kneading the warm floor, then the punchline is the cat fully melted flat in bliss
